description: This is a Java unit test class for the ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy. It tests the behavior of modifying feature properties on a 'Thing' object within the Eclipse Ditto project, including various scenarios such as missing features, existing properties, and handling of metadata.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy in different scenarios, covering error handling, proper modifications, and metadata handling.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static variables for the tests, such as feature ID, property pointer, and new property value.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the strategy class is immutable.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyOnThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests modifying a feature property on a 'Thing' with no features, expecting a feature not found exception.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyOnThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Tests modifying a feature property on a 'Thing' where the specific feature is missing, expecting a feature not found exception.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertyOfFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Tests modifying a feature property when the feature exists but has no properties.

methods.name: modifyExistingFeatureProperty
methods.description: Tests modifying an existing feature property successfully.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Tests modifying a feature property along with setting metadata.

methods.name: restrictMetadataUnderExistingFields
methods.description: Ensures that metadata attached to modifications only applies under existing fields in the property object.
